import re
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from collections import defaultdict

# Login Simple Note and compute shares from the two Work Dinner notes
sn_pw = next(p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='simple_note')
simple_access_token = apis.simple_note.login(username='cod.smith@gmail.com', password=sn_pw)['access_token']

pattern=re.compile(r"-\s*(.+?)\s*=>\s*\$(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)")
shares=defaultdict(float)
for note_id in [3084,3085]:
    note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=note_id, access_token=simple_access_token)
    content=note.get('content','')
    for line in content.splitlines():
        m=pattern.search(line)
        if m:
            name=m.group(1).strip()
            shares[name]+=float(m.group(2))
shares=dict(shares)
print('shares:', {k:shares[k] for k in sorted(shares)})

# Get yesterday date from phone
ph_pw = next(p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='phone')
phone_token = apis.phone.login(username='7826309761', password=ph_pw)['access_token']
cur_dt=apis.phone.get_current_date_and_time()
print('phone_now', cur_dt)

m=re.match(r"\w+, (\w+) (\d+), (\d{4})", cur_dt['date'])
mon_map={'Jan':'01','Feb':'02','Mar':'03','Apr':'04','May':'05','Jun':'06','Jul':'07','Aug':'08','Sep':'09','Oct':'10','Nov':'11','Dec':'12'}
mon=mon_map[m.group(1)[:3]]
day=int(m.group(2)); year=int(m.group(3))
# yesterday
from datetime import date
# compute yesterday date iso
yesterday_date=(datetime(year,int(mon),day)-timedelta(days=1)).date().isoformat()
today_date=datetime(year,int(mon),day).date().isoformat()
print('yesterday_date', yesterday_date, 'today_date', today_date)

# Login Venmo
venmo_pw = next(p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='venmo')
venmo_access_token = apis.venmo.login(username='cod.smith@gmail.com', password=venmo_pw)['access_token']

# Fetch Venmo received transactions for yesterday
page_index=0
page_limit=20
received_amount_by_email=defaultdict(float)
while True:
    res=apis.venmo.show_transactions(access_token=venmo_access_token, direction='received', min_created_at=yesterday_date, max_created_at=yesterday_date, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not res:
        break
    for t in res:
        if t.get('description')=='Work Dinner':
            email=t.get('sender',{}).get('email')
            if email:
                received_amount_by_email[email]+=float(t.get('amount',0.0))
    page_index+=1

print('received_amount_by_email (Work Dinner):', {k:received_amount_by_email[k] for k in sorted(received_amount_by_email)})

# Resolve each coworker via phone contacts to their venmo user email
# Phone contact resolution: search_contacts(query=name), then exact-match on first_name==name (case-insensitive)

def phone_contacts_for_name(name):
    allc=[]
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    while True:
        page=apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, query=name, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if not page:
            break
        allc.extend(page)
        page_index+=1
    # exact-match filter
    filtered=[c for c in allc if c.get('first_name','').strip().lower()==name.strip().lower()]
    return allc, filtered

# Venmo user resolution from phone contact email

def venmo_users_for_email(email):
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    allu=[]
    while True:
        page=apis.venmo.search_users(access_token=venmo_access_token, query=email, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if not page:
            break
        allu.extend(page)
        page_index+=1
    # exact-match filter on email
    filtered=[u for u in allu if u.get('email','').strip().lower()==email.strip().lower()]
    return allu, filtered

resolved={}
for person in sorted(shares.keys()):
    allc, filtered=phone_contacts_for_name(person)
    print('\nContact search for', person, 'returned', len(allc), 'filtered_exact_first_name', len(filtered))
    # show first few candidates
    print('Filtered contacts:', [(c.get('first_name'), c.get('last_name'), c.get('email'), c.get('phone_number')) for c in filtered[:10]])
    # choose contacts that have email
    contacts_with_email=[c for c in filtered if c.get('email')]
    if not contacts_with_email:
        print('NO phone contact with email for', person)
        continue
    # If multiple, we'll try to resolve all to venmo and keep ones that exist.
    venmo_emails=[]
    for c in contacts_with_email:
        email=c['email']
        allu, filt=venmo_users_for_email(email)
        print('  Venmo search by email', email, 'returned', len(allu), 'filtered_exact_email', len(filt))
        if filt:
            venmo_emails.append(email)
    # Deduplicate
    venmo_emails=sorted(set(venmo_emails))
    print('Resolved venmo emails for', person, ':', venmo_emails)
    if venmo_emails:
        resolved[person]=venmo_emails

print('\nResolved mapping (person -> venmo emails):', resolved)

# For received amounts, match by sender email to resolved mapping (if multiple venmo emails, sum their received)
received_amount_by_person=defaultdict(float)
for person, emails in resolved.items():
    for e in emails:
        received_amount_by_person[person]+=received_amount_by_email.get(e,0.0)

print('Received amount by person (from resolved mapping):', {p:received_amount_by_person[p] for p in sorted(received_amount_by_person)})

# Compute remaining
remaining_by_person={}
for person, share_amt in shares.items():
    rec=received_amount_by_person.get(person,0.0)
    remaining=round(share_amt-rec,2)
    remaining_by_person[person]=remaining

print('Remaining by person:', {p:remaining_by_person[p] for p in sorted(remaining_by_person)})

# Build target requests: remaining > 0 and person resolved to exactly one venmo email (to avoid ambiguity)
request_targets=[]
for person, rem in remaining_by_person.items():
    if rem>0.0:
        emails=resolved.get(person,[])
        if len(emails)==1:
            request_targets.append((person, emails[0], float(rem)))
        else:
            print('Ambiguous or missing venmo email for', person, 'emails', emails)

print('\nRequest targets:', request_targets)

# Login Venmo

venmo_access_token = apis.venmo.login(username='cod.smith@gmail.com', password=venmo_pw)['access_token']

# Targets from parsed notes and received yesterday
request_targets = [
    ('Sandra', 'saritt@gmail.com', 37.0),
    ('Stephen', 'stmcco@gmail.com', 20.0),
    ('Travis', 'tra_wils@gmail.com', 39.0),
    ('Sabrina', 'sab-brown@gmail.com', 21.0),
    ('Grant', 'gra-martinez@gmail.com', 22.0),
    ('Allison', 'allison-calhoun@gmail.com', 37.0),
]

# Fetch all sent payment requests (paginate)
page_index=0
page_limit=20
all_sent=[]
while True:
    res = apis.venmo.show_sent_payment_requests(access_token=venmo_access_token, query='', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('sent_payment_requests page', page_index, 'n', len(res))
    if not res:
        break
    all_sent.extend(res)
    page_index += 1
print('total sent payment requests', len(all_sent))

# Build map of existing non-denied payment requests keyed by (receiver_email, amount)
existing = []
existing_by_key = defaultdict(list)
for r in all_sent:
    receiver_email = (r.get('receiver') or {}).get('email')
    amt = float(r.get('amount')) if r.get('amount') is not None else None
    if not receiver_email or amt is None:
        continue
    amt_key = round(amt,2)
    approved_at = r.get('approved_at')
    denied_at = r.get('denied_at')
    status = 'pending' if (approved_at is None and denied_at is None) else ('denied' if denied_at is not None else 'approved')
    existing_by_key[(receiver_email.lower(), amt_key)].append((r['payment_request_id'], r.get('description',''), status, r.get('created_at')))

# Determine which requests still need creation (i.e., no non-denied request with same receiver+amount)
needed=[]
for person,email,amt in request_targets:
    key=(email.lower(), round(float(amt),2))
    pending_or_approved = [x for x in existing_by_key.get(key, []) if x[2] in ('pending','approved')]
    if pending_or_approved:
        print('SKIP (already has', len(pending_or_approved), ') for', person, key, pending_or_approved)
    else:
        needed.append((person,email,float(amt)))

print('needed count', len(needed))
